mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO logan_http (app_id, device_id, platform, kind, method, url, host, path, status, err_kind, err_msg, duration_ms, connect_ms, dns_ms, ttfb_ms, req_bytes, resp_bytes, slow, page_url, trace_id, app_version, build_version, os, os_version, brand, model, network_type, extra, occurred_at, fingerprint, dedup_hash, add_time) VALUES (#{appId}, #{deviceId}, #{platform}, #{kind}, #{method}, #{url}, #{host}, #{path}, #{status}, #{errKind}, #{errMsg}, #{durationMs}, #{connectMs}, #{dnsMs}, #{ttfbMs}, #{reqBytes}, #{respBytes}, #{slow}, #{pageUrl}, #{traceId}, #{appVersion}, #{buildVersion}, #{os}, #{osVersion}, #{brand}, #{model}, #{networkType}, #{extra}, #{occurredAt}, #{fingerprint}, #{dedupHash}, #{addTime})

app_id = #{appId} AND occurred_at >= #{beginTime} AND occurred_at <= #{endTime}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO logan_http_issue (app_id, fingerprint, kind, method, host, path, status, err_kind, title, sample_url, sample_device_id, sample_trace_id, error_count, slow_count, total_count, avg_ms, max_ms, last_err_msg, affected_devices, status_flag, first_seen, last_seen, add_time) VALUES (#{appId}, #{fingerprint}, #{kind}, #{method}, #{host}, #{path}, #{status}, #{errKind}, #{title}, #{sampleUrl}, #{sampleDeviceId}, #{sampleTraceId}, #{errorCount}, #{slowCount}, #{totalCount}, #{avgMs}, #{maxMs}, #{lastErrMsg}, #{affectedDevices}, #{statusFlag}, #{firstSeen}, #{lastSeen}, #{addTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_count = total_count + 1, error_count = error_count + VALUES(error_count), slow_count = slow_count + VALUES(slow_count), avg_ms = VALUES(avg_ms), max_ms = GREATEST(max_ms, VALUES(max_ms)), last_err_msg = COALESCE(VALUES(last_err_msg), last_err_msg), sample_url = VALUES(sample_url), sample_device_id = VALUES(sample_device_id), sample_trace_id = VALUES(sample_trace_id), title = VALUES(title), last_seen = GREATEST(last_seen, VALUES(last_seen))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM logan_http_issue WHERE app_id = #{appId} AND fingerprint = #{fingerprint} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE logan_http_issue SET llm_summary = #{llmSummary}, llm_severity = #{llmSeverity} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE logan_http_issue SET assignee = #{assignee} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE logan_http_issue SET close_note = #{closeNote} WHERE id = #{id}
